# High-speed configuration descriptor of a composite device: a HID
# interface 0 (USB HID 1.11: its HID descriptor and an interrupt IN
# endpoint, EP2 IN), then a UAC2 sink whose IAD bounds interfaces 1
# (AudioControl) and 2 (AudioStreaming, one alternate setting of the
# format 24/3, as uac2-hs-24-3.txt). One descriptor per line, in hex,
# wTotalLength bytes in all.
